an7.37:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] sattahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhumitto sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo api panujjamānenapi.
an7.37:1.3: piyo ca hoti manāpo ca, garu ca, bhāvanīyo ca, vattā ca, vacanakkhamo ca, gambhīrañca kathaṃ kattā hoti, no ca aṭṭhāne niyojeti.
an7.37:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave, sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhumitto sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo api panujjamānenapīti.
